description.ar: توليد صور سريع باستخدام SD3.5 Large Turbo - نموذج مُقطَّر من 4 خطوات لنتائج شبه فورية
description.bg: Бързо генериране на изображения с SD3.5 Large Turbo - дестилиран модел с 4 стъпки за почти мигновени резултати

meta.notes: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation from SD3.5 Large. 4 steps, CFG 0.0. Same triple encoder setup (CLIP-L + CLIP-G + T5-XXL). The interception prompt (translated by Stage 3) is passed through unchanged to all three encoders — the regular SD3 path (paper Fig. 2a). No per-encoder keyword splitting.

training_data_sources: Undisclosed (distilled from SD3.5 Large — same training data basis)
